name: Seacats Application Form Thingy
summary: Volunteer application form for Seacats, an indie game studio; asks for positions, experience and a contact handle.
description: A Google Form recruiting volunteers for Seacats, an unpaid indie game studio. It lists the areas it needs help with (3D artists, writers, programmers, management, promo, game/UI design, software engineering, voice acting, vfx, legal advice) and collects the positions you want, your motivation, previous experience, whether you are queer and Indian, and a username plus platform for contact.
contains: asks for interested positions, motivation, experience and a contact handle + platform
open areas: 3D art, writing, programming, management, promo, game/UI design, voice acting, vfx, legal advice
states the work is unpaid and voluntary
